name: ZSF_FCST_SERIES
description: Master table which stores the forecast series defintion in forecasting application

columns.name: FCST_SERIES_ID
columns.description: Primary Key  representing the series ID . This will be used to represent a forecast series setup

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of Forecast Series. Currently we forecast only on Revenue

columns.name: FCST_PERIOD_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Forecast period. This is dervived from GL calendar

columns.name: ADJ_PERIOD_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Adjustment period corresponding to the GL calendar selected.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_FORECASTS
columns.description: Number of Forecasts for a given forecast period

columns.name: FIRST_FCST_DUE_DATE_OFFSET
columns.description: Number of days before/after the start date , when the forecast is due

columns.name: DUE_DATE_OFFSET_TYPE
columns.description: Represents whether the due date offset is before or after

columns.name: TERR_HIER_FREEZE_OFFSET
columns.description: Territory Hierarchy freeze date offset, before the start date.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the forecast series is active or draft

columns.name: SUBMITTED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Ess Request Id of the current forecast stored for reference

columns.name: PIPELINE_REVN_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected pipeline revenue metric is enabled

columns.name: BEST_CASE_FCST_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected bestcase revenue metric is enabled

columns.name: WORST_CASE_FCST_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected worst case revenue metric is enabled

columns.name: CLOSED_REVENUE_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected closed revenue metric is enabled

columns.name: PREDICTED_ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected predicted adjustment metric is enabled

columns.name: QUOTA_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected quota metric is enabled

columns.name: EXPECTED_REVN_FLAG
columns.description: If this is selected expected revenue metric is enabled

columns.name: FCST_CRITERIA_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates if the criteria override is permitted for the forecast setup

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Reference to the GL calendar selected for CRM

columns.name: CORP_CURR_CODE
columns.description: Corporate Currency Code selected for the CRM

columns.name: CORP_CURR_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Corporate Currency Rate Type of the CRM currency

columns.name: NON_REVN_FCST_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to enable non revenue forecasting for the setup

columns.name: REMOVE_FROZEN_FORECAST
columns.description: This flag indicates if the user wants to remove frozen forecasts before a regenerate.

columns.name: PROD_SUMMARY_ADJUST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the product summary adjustment is enabled.

columns.name: PROD_HIER_ADJUST_LEVEL
columns.description: Level of product hierarachy upto which summary adjustment can be handled

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the product hierarchy snapshot was last refreshed from the product schema

columns.name: NEXT_SUMMARY_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: Stores the time at which the next scheduled metrics refresh process will start.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_PERIODS
columns.description: Stores the number of scheduled current and future periods for which forecasts can be generated.

columns.name: CONCURRENT_FORECASTS
columns.description: Stores the number of concurrent forecasts to be generated

columns.name: REVN_METRICS_REFRESH_DATE
columns.description: This column has the last refresh date of revenue metrics data.

columns.name: TREND_GRAPH_FLAG
columns.description: Control whether trend graph flag is displayed in the Fuse Overview Page

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_NOTES_FLAG
columns.description: ADJUSTMENT_NOTES_FLAG

columns.name: AUTO_PILOT_STATUS
columns.description:
'AUTOPILOT' if the user clicked on the 'Enable Forecasting' checkbox. (Check box is ON)
NULL if the application is upgraded from an earlier release. (Check box is ON)
'MANUAL' if the application is upgraded from an earlier release and admin has manually enabled autopilot (Check box is ON)

columns.name: AUTO_PILOT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request ID of the recurring job scheduled for forecasting autopilot

columns.name: AUTO_PILOT_NOTIFY_EMAILS
columns.description: Comma separated list of email addresses to which notifications about autopilot jobs should be sent

columns.name: LAST_DIAGNOSTICS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Last Run Diagnostic job id to be fetched on page load in admin UI.

columns.name: RESOURCE_FORECASTING_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates if customer has enabled Resource Based Forecasting

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
